{{Quote|Back to his base. Back to his most secure area, where his treasures are stored. His personal vault.|Mulus Cheems on Kosh Teradoc's base|<ref name="MK" />}}
This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] '''base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]] and was controlled by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]]. The base included underground research-and-development laboratories located deep beneath the installation, where Teradoc's personnel experimented with plague viruses and self-replicating nonbiological toxins. Directly underneath the laboratories was Teradoc's personal vault. In the event of a biological containment breach, the facility was designed to automatically seal its vents and activate decontamination systems that incinerated and chemically sterilized the affected areas.<ref name="MK" />

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> Teradoc brought his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Mulus Cheems]] out of the base to authenticate a statuette supposedly recovered from [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]], a famed treasure [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. After Cheems confirmed that the statuette was genuine, Teradoc attempted to double cross [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, to seize the entire treasure for himself.<ref name="MK" />

Hachat then gave a signal and the other undercover Wraiths, who were working various jobs throughout the club, sprang into action. Following the brief skirmish, the Wraiths escaped with Cheems while Teradoc returned to the base with the statuette. Unbeknownst to him, it was actually an explosive made from modified crystallized [[Anthracite|anthracite]]. After regrouping aboard Teradoc's stolen [[Teradoc's yacht|yacht]], the Wraiths monitored the statuette's concealed planetary positioning system and atmospheric pressure sensors. Once Teradoc carried it into his underground personal vault, the device detected that it had reached its predetermined depth and location, triggering an explosion that destroyed both the laboratories and Teradoc's personal vault.<ref name="MK" />
